title: Looks Good, But Too Dull to Make Zest or Curls
text:
Looks Good, But Too Dull to Make Zest or Curls. This SAVORA STAINLESS STEEL BAR ZESTER looks fabulous, but it's so dull, it won't produce either zest or curls from a thick-skinned supermarket lemon (see, e.g., [[ASIN:B008NW0GHO Tropicana Premium Fresh Lemons]]). To even attempt to use it--applying considerable force--you need to turn it upside down (Savora label underneath) to get the "sharp" edges turned toward the lemon skin.

If you need a zester, OXO makes a very good one that actually does the things that this one claims to do (see [[ASIN:B00004OCJO B00004OCJO Good Grips Lemon Zester]]).
